title: Israeli Drone Strike Kills Two Near Gaza City Municipal Park
detail: An Israeli drone strike on Monday, August 31, 2026 hit the entrance of a residential building near Gaza City's municipal public park — an area packed with displaced families — killing two Palestinians and wounding several others. Al-Shifa Hospital received the two bodies. The Israeli military said the strike targeted operatives from Hamas's armed wing, the Ezzedine al-Qassam Brigades, without providing further evidence.

media.caption: Mourners react during the funeral of a Palestinian killed in Israeli strikes in Gaza City, August 31, 2026

title: Israeli Drone Strike Destroys Vehicle in Tal al-Hawa, Killing Three
detail: Later on Monday, August 31, 2026, an Israeli drone strike hit a civilian car in the Tal al-Hawa neighborhood, southwest/west of Gaza City, killing at least three Palestinians. Al-Shifa Hospital received three bodies. Civil defense images showed the vehicle reduced to a blackened, warped shell as bystanders and first responders extinguished the fire. The Israeli military said it had attacked Hamas Ezzedine al-Qassam Brigades operatives travelling in the vehicle, without providing further detail. The strike was one of two separate attacks in Gaza City that day, bringing Monday's toll to at least five killed.

media.caption: Destroyed vehicle after an Israeli drone strike in the Tal al-Hawa neighbourhood, Gaza City, August 31, 2026
